title: Locally-Running AI Assistant Integrated with Messaging Apps
oneLiner: OpenClaw is an open-source, locally-running AI assistant that connects to WhatsApp, Telegram, or other chat apps to manage inboxes, calendars, and automated workflows via custom "skills".
evidenceDetail: The provider's own documentation describes this workflow, its requirements, and its setup steps. Zyvibe checked the linked source on 2026-11-21 and has not reproduced the workflow.
whatItDoes: OpenClaw is an open-source, locally-running AI assistant that connects to WhatsApp, Telegram, or other chat apps to manage inboxes, calendars, and automated workflows via custom "skills".
requirements: messaging app API credentials (e.g., Telegram Bot Token)
steps: Configure a messaging app integration (e.g., Telegram)
Install or write a custom "skill" (e.g., calendar lookup)
Send a command via the chat app to trigger the workflow.
configSnippet: "Check my calendar for next week and draft a summary of my available slots, then send it to this chat."
limitations: Requires self-hosting and maintenance of the local environment
messaging API rate limits may apply.
